messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 pager — Possible data residency violation detected for customer 'acme-eu' (acct: acct-871). Smart-routing fallback chose us-east-1 for requests marked region=EU. Sample log lines attached. Paging on-call now.

lindsay: on it. can someone drop the link to the traffic sample?

ravi: grabbing logs now. looks like a recent routing policy change rolled at 2024-10-02T03:42:10Z that introduced a fallback group mapping 'eu->global' for model-variants.

ops-bot: Affected requests last 15m: 2,174; unique users: 12; PII flag count: 84. Top target region: us-east-1.

lindsay: thanks @ravi and @ops-bot — initial priority is stop any further cross-region fallbacks. plan: disable the smart-routing fallback policy and pin acme-eu to strict residency. ravi, can you take the kill switch?

ravi: doing. running:
```
redwoodctl routing policy disable --name smart-fallback-global-eu
redwoodctl customer set-residency --customer acct-871 --region eu-west-1 --strict
```

ravi: disabled fallback policy at 03:45:02Z. policy state: DISABLED.

lindsay: confirm that new requests from acme-eu are being routed to eu-west-1 only?

ops-bot: policy change propagated to all edge routers by 03:45:12Z. Observability: immediate drop in us-east-1 traffic for acct-871 from 220rps -> 0rps within 20s for matching request signature.

maria_priv: quick legal check — if PII has touched us-east-1 storage, we need to follow breach assessment even if transient. pls capture which requests hit which model instances and whether logs/payloads were persisted.

sam_platform: digging into instance logs. early sign: the majority of affected requests hit a fallback model variant 'gptx-8b-compat' hosted in us-east-1. KV cache writeback is disabled for that variant, but request traces show some debug-level logs that might contain truncated prompts. I will audit storage buckets next.

paul_support: reported customer visibility: acme reported increased latency and an internal alert at 03:44. They are asking if data left EU. we need a concise customer-facing statement.

lindsay: agreed. immediate customer message: "We detected routing policy mismatch that temporarily routed a subset of requests outside your selected region. We have disabled the fallback and are investigating whether any persisted data left the EU. We'll update within 3 hours." @paul_support can you send that?

paul_support: posting now. copy to #cs-acme for tracking.

ravi: audit results so far:
- model instances touched in us-east-1: i-0a1b2c3d (gptx-8b-compat), i-0f1e2d3c (gptx-8b-compat)
- object store writes (last 24h) for acct-871 in us-east-1: 0
- temporary trace blobs flagged: 84 entries (transient, retained 15m), stored in ephemeral-logs (no replication).

sam_platform: ephemeral-logs retention policy is 15m and logs are auto-purged. We verified no snapshots or long-term storage for those blobs.

maria_priv: we still need to assume potential exposure until we complete the full forensics. open an incident evidence package. include hashes of the ephemeral blobs before purge.

lindsay: action items:
- ravi: collect instance-level forensic dump (read-only), preserve ephemeral-logs hashes. (ETA 1h)
- sam_platform: verify storage write paths and ensure no snapshots. (ETA 1h)
- maria_priv: prepare legal notification draft and escalation criteria. (ETA 2h)
- paul_support: customer comms and log timeline. (immediate)
- lindsay: follow-up and coordinate with infra-sre for rollback if needed.

ravi: starting read-only forensic snapshot command now:
```
redwoodctl forensic capture --instances i-0a1b2c3d,i-0f1e2d3c --mode readonly --output s3://incidents-preserve/1775001234/
```
Command accepted, snapshot job id = fj-3391.

ops-bot: snapshot job fj-3391 started (03:52:09Z). Estimated time: 18m.

sam_platform: confirmed no long-term S3 writes. There is one autoscaler that had a misconfigured env var ROUTE_FALLBACK=global which caused the variant to accept cross-region requests. patching that now.

lindsay: good catch. we need a postmortem item to add e2e tests for ROUTE_FALLBACK per-deployment and customer residency enforced at routing edge.

maria_priv: draft legal notice ready. key lines: "We are conducting a forensic investigation; immediate mitigation steps have been taken; based on preliminary evidence we have no indication of data persisted in non-EU long-term storage. We will inform you within 3 hours or sooner." will send to leadership for sign-off.

paul_support: customer updated in thread, acme replied: "Appreciate the quick action. Please confirm within the hour if any persisted data left EU."

lindsay: estimated blast radius update: ~2k requests (past 15m) matched fallback signature, 84 transient blobs, no confirmed persisted writes. severity remains SEV2 until forensics complete.

ops-bot: monitoring rule created: residency-violation-watch-acct-871. alert if any traffic to non-eu regions observed for acct-871.

ravi: forensic snapshot complete (04:11:02Z). uploading to secure bucket s3://incidents-preserve/1775001234/ completed. hashes: [sha256:3a7f..., sha256:9b1c...].

sam_platform: patched autoscaler env var and deployed a fix to edge routing to enforce per-customer residency at the edge (no fallback permitted). rollout completed 04:18:44Z to 3 regions.

maria_priv: legal sign-off received. recommendation: notify regulators if any persisted PII confirmed; for now communicate containment and ongoing investigation.

lindsay: next steps: create postmortem ticket, assign owners for remediation actions (tests, infra guardrails, monitoring), schedule follow-up with acme in 2 hours. handing off to next oncall @ravi for follow-through. I will join the follow-up sync.

ravi: acknowledged, taking handoff. I'll run a final sweep for any lingering non-eu traffic and validate alerting thresholds.

paul_support: tracking ticket INC-177500 on the support side. I'll keep customer updated and share the incident evidence bundle once legal approves. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Under investigation. Handoff: lindsay -> ravi.

lindsay: thanks team — big props for quick actions. we'll have a writeup and timeline by EOD and a full postmortem within 48h. :shield:
